files..github/workflows/approve-request.yml:
name: Approve Request

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - ready_for_review
  issue_comment:
    types:
      - created

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: approve-request-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.issue.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  approve:
    name: approve
    if: |
      (
        github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' &&
        contains(fromJSON('["civitaspo", "cursoragent", "renovate[bot]", "dependabot[bot]", "civitaspo-securefix-server[bot]"]'), github.actor)
      ) || (
        github.event_name == 'issue_comment' &&
        github.event.issue.pull_request &&
        github.event.comment.body == '/approve' &&
        github.event.comment.user.login == 'civitaspo'
      )
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    timeout-minutes: 10
    env:
      SECUREFIX_CLIENT_APP_ID: ${{ vars.SECUREFIX_CLIENT_APP_ID }}
      SECUREFIX_SERVER_REPOSITORY: ${{ vars.SECUREFIX_SERVER_REPOSITORY }}

    steps:
      - name: Check Securefix configuration
        env:
          CLIENT_APP_ID: ${{ env.SECUREFIX_CLIENT_APP_ID }}
          CLIENT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SECUREFIX_CLIENT_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          SERVER_REPOSITORY: ${{ env.SECUREFIX_SERVER_REPOSITORY }}
        run: |
          if [[ -z "${CLIENT_APP_ID}" || -z "${CLIENT_PRIVATE_KEY}" || "${SERVER_REPOSITORY}" != "securefix-server" ]]; then
            echo "Securefix approval configuration is incomplete." >&2
            echo "Configure SECUREFIX_CLIENT_APP_ID, SECUREFIX_SERVER_REPOSITORY=securefix-server, and SECUREFIX_CLIENT_PRIVATE_KEY." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Request pull request approval
        uses: csm-actions/approve-pr-action@452271472f121d6d2f8e7a0761488d2fcc29b715 # v0.2.0
        with:
          app_id: ${{ env.SECUREFIX_CLIENT_APP_ID }}
          app_private_key: ${{ secrets.SECUREFIX_CLIENT_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          server_repository_name: ${{ env.SECUREFIX_SERVER_REPOSITORY }}
          pull_request_number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.issue.number }}
          allowed_committers: |
            civitaspo
            cursoragent
            renovate[bot]
            dependabot[bot]
            civitaspo-securefix-server[bot]

      ) || (
